expectations.note: With 10-undercover-47 playing from /opt/nothingness/media, the cross-folder action was present at /opt/nothingness and one activation returned to /opt/nothingness/media with row 47 visible.

In the already-correct media folder, the action was exposed while row 47 was off-screen and the row became visible with the folder unchanged, but the first activation did not move the list and a second activation was needed.
After row 47 was fully visible, the active accessible jump action remained exposed in the semantics tree instead of disappearing.
After playback ended with songInfo null and isPlaying false, captures in both the media folder and its parent showed no jump action.
The active affordance appeared in the semantics tree with the distinguishing label 'jump to now-playing track' and a tap action.
The candidate's before_jump.png genuinely showed playback of 47 while the browser displayed only later rows (50–54), and the matching pre-state capture showed 47 absent.
The candidate's after_jump.png was visually identical to before_jump.png and still omitted row 47, so the required submitted after screenshot was not on-point.
The write-up claimed activation scrolled the row into view, but its session contained no supporting state read and the submitted after screenshot contradicted that claim.
An on-screen folder tap changed to /opt/nothingness/media, an on-screen track tap started playback, and next, previous, pause, and resume all responded with the expected final live state.
Repeated navigation, jump activation, and playback controls left the app responsive; the final runtime inspection showed a live app and zero overflow reports.
